text:
olivia: Hey runtime team — final ask before we lock the webinar and the launch post. We need a small, reproducible bench artifact pack + a short sanity run that matches the numbers in the draft narrative. Can you help? :pray:
anya: Thanks for the heads-up. What exactly do you need in the artifact pack?
olivia: Minimal but complete. Ideally:
- raw run logs (per-request latency, cpu/gpu, model variant)
- the payloads used (random seed noted)
- config: batch sizes, quantization flags, warmup policy
- 50-sample tail set + 95/99 pctiles + p99.9 if cheap to compute
- short notes on non-deterministic factors (cache hits, cold starts)
marcos: OK we can do that. Which model and hw slice should we run? A100 vs H100 makes a noticeable diff.
sam: Also need to know target SLOs you're claiming so we can replicate percentiles at the correct qps/warmup.
olivia: For the press narrative we call out: median latency 60–80ms (tok), p95 < 200ms, p99 < 400ms for the small-text demo (256 tokens) on H100 with int8 quantization. Webinar wants a longer-context slide (2k tokens) where we show tradeoffs.
devon: Noted. For 2k tokens we should include both streaming and non-streaming runs. Streaming adds headroom but changes tail characteristics.
olivia: Good call — include both. Also include a short note for marketing copy: "warmup policy: 3x auto-batch windows, prefix cache enabled"
marcos: We'll spin a dedicated job. Quick clarifying Qs:
1) Seed for sampling? use marketing-provided sample-seed-2026 or pick RNG?
2) Quant variants: int8 + float16? any special kernel flags?
3) Do you want raw token-level latencies or aggregated per-request only?
anya: 1) use marketing-provided seed (I'll DM the file). 2) include int8 and fp16; if there's an int4-safe quant path, include that as "experimental". 3) both token-level and per-request aggregates, but if token-level is heavy just include a small subset (10 requests) with token traces.
sam: Great. We'll produce: artifact.tar.gz with a manifest.json (detailing run commands and env), raw CSVs for per-request metrics, and a short README. We'll also attach a 1-slide PNG with p95/p99 bars for easy copy into the deck.
olivia: Perfect. Timeline? We have a dry-run of the webinar on Thursday EOD. Can we get the artifacts by Wed 10am PT?
marcos: Wed 7am PT is doable for the smoke pack (repro commands + small sample). Full sweep (all variants) needs until Wed 6pm PT. Is the smoke pack enough for you to proceed?
olivia: Smoke pack by Wed 7am PT is fine — that'll let us validate messaging and lock slides. If we see anything weird we'll ask for the full sweep.
devon: One more thing — we'll include run annotations about caching: exact cache TTLs, whether KV prefix sharing was enabled, and any warmup traffic. That helps explain differences in coldstart vs steady-state.
anya: I'll drop the sample seed and the short payload list in #marketing-assets in 10m. Also marking the message in Notion to track acceptance.
marcos: Putting a job in the queue now. runtime-bot: job 78921 queued on h100-pool, expected runtime ~2h for smoke, deps: model-v3-int8, model-v3-fp16.
olivia: Thanks all — will flag in the webinar prep doc when artifacts land. :thumbsup:
marcos: If anything blocks the reproducibility (eg missing seed or mismatched model weights) we'll ping the thread immediately.
anya: Appreciate it — if you can include a tiny OSS-style run command in the README that others can run locally (approx: docker run + env vars) that's ideal for transparency.
sam: Will do. Example command we'll include:
```
MODEL=model-v3-int8 RUN_SEED=marketing-provided ./run_bench.sh --qps 50 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
marcos: ETA: smoke artifacts uploaded to GCS at gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5160701234/smoke.tar.gz by Wed 07:00 PT. Full sweep path will be posted when complete.
olivia: Amazing — thank you. This helps close the launch narrative loop.
marcos: np, catching up in the run results channel once uploaded.
runtime-bot: upload 78921 completed: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5160701234/smoke.tar.gz (3.4MB)
olivia: Got it, downloading now. If we need clarifications I'll reply here.
anya: I'll review the manifest and call out any copy edits before the deck is finalized.
marcos: standing by.
